fragment.excerpt: AA11393US — Deferred Filing, Disclosure, and EP Work MemoCANONICAL SHARED CONTROL MEMO · STATUS 23 JULY 2026INTERNAL COUNSEL WORK PLAN — NOT FOR FILING. This memo controls for both NA and AF ; strategy-specific documents may add stricter gates but may not silently relax this register.This memo controls outstanding US and EP prosecution work. Outstanding work is not optional or safe to postpone beyond an applicable deadline. US and EP counsel must confirm the operative requirements and dates, assign responsible persons, and record completion evidence.1. Purpose and controlThis memo is the control document for outstanding: [Decimal] [Period] prior-art document retrieval and verification;continuing IDS and counterpart-search monitoring;US filing formalities, applicant identity, ownership, and recordation;provisional/PCT continuity and priority-document checks;European-phase entry and the separate later Rule 161/162 response workstream; andcounsel-approved circulation, access, retention, legal-hold, and prosecution-record controls.The alternative substantive strategies are routed through ../README.md and maintained separately under ../normal-allowance/ and ../allowance-first/ . The canonical disclosure inventory is AA11393US-US_IDS-reference-list_DRAFT.md , and the strategy-neutral successor procedure is AA11393US-continuation-preservation_MEMO.md .The strategy-neutral docket-date snapshot below is an internal reminder only and does not substitute for an attorney-controlled docket. Counsel must independently confirm all US, PCT, Italian, and EP deadlines and use an earlier internal filing target where appropriate.Repository labels are handling instructions only; DW-12 requires US counsel to determine the package's legal/confidentiality treatment, circulation, access, version control, retention, and preservation.Except for DW-12's initial-transmission handling control, an open register item does not bar the applicant's controlled initial transmission of this prepared decision package to prospective or retained US counsel. In particular, DW-08A is a tracked post-engagement, pre-final-claim task: the package records the search gap and may be transmitted before the professional search or requested legal opinions are complete. Open items still control the later filing, representation, or broadening decision identified in their respective gates.Shared docket-date snapshot [AlignDefault] [ColWidthDefault] [AlignDefault] [ColWidthDefault] [AlignDefault] Date or trigger [AlignDefault] Matter and control [AlignDefault] 26 June 2026 [AlignDefault] WIPO's recommended 28-month date for informal comments has passed. A general statement that “the family supports the claim” does not complete DW-05A.
